name: The St. Regis Bermuda Resort
positioning: Oceanfront St. Regis resort on St. Catherine's Beach in St. George's, Bermuda
best_for: Beach lovers who want to stay steps from the sand
Golfers who want the Five Forts Golf Club on hand
Travelers interested in Bermuda's early history

facts.text: The resort is just steps from St. Catherine's Beach.
The Town of St. George's and St. Catherine's Beach, where the resort sits, are both UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
The pool deck has two swimming pools, loungers and private cabanas.
Lina restaurant is named after Caroline Astor.
Lina serves local ingredients prepared with a Latin twist.
Champagne sabrage, the signature St. Regis Evening Ritual ceremony, is offered daily.
Every Sunday the lawn in front of Lina becomes an Italian-inspired country market.
The Five Forts golf course is named for the five forts that surround it, starting near Fort Victoria and finishing at Fort St. Catherine.
Five Forts Golf Club partners with the Golfzon Leadbetter Academy for instruction.
Each accommodation has a private balcony.
The spa has an outdoor plunge pool.
Vincent Astor, son of John Jacob Astor, kept a 22-acre estate in St. George's Ferry Reach.

highlights.text: In 1609 Admiral Sir George Somers and the first colonists landed at St. Catherine's Beach.
The Gates Bay Mary cocktail is named after the bay bordering the resort and features native fennel, Goslings Black Seal Rum and Outerbridge's original sherry pepper sauce.
Guests have access to the 18-hole Five Forts Golf Club, with ocean views from nearly every hole.
The John Jacob Astor Suite is the largest suite and includes a butler pantry.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service; L.F. Wade Airport is about 6.8 km or 8 minutes away.
Rooms offer ocean, golf course or garden views, so not every room faces the ocean.
The golf pro shop is open from March to November.
